interface.title: RIPER Tools for TURBOMOLE
interface.field: Computational materials science / periodic DFT (TURBOMOLE riper module)
interface.stage_of_work: Preparing calculation input (structure conversion, k-point path, cell orthogonalization) and analysing finished runs (SCF output, band structure, density of states)
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit app that turns crystal structure files into RIPER control/coord blocks and k-point paths, then parses and plots riper outputs: SCF convergence, band structures (plain and fat bands) and total or projected DOS. The app's navigation also lists pages this run did not explore: database import (Materials Project / PubChem to RIPER), structure building (Surface Builder, Place Adsorbate on Surface, Pack Molecules in Cell), RT-TDDFT and embedding input creation, spectrum plotters (LR-TDDFT UV-Vis, RT-TDDFT absorption, HHG), cube processing, and help pages (Keywords Help, Convergence Tips, Examples, References). This tree covers only the band-structure, DOS and input-preparation part of the app.

data.note: I uploaded input.cif (a hexagonal BN monolayer in a 15 Å cell), bands.xyz (bulk Si, 74 bands × 400 k-points), bands_proj.xyz (MgO fat bands, 116 bands × 61 k-points, 8 weight buckets), dos with pdos_el_mg, pdos_el_o, pdos_at1_mg and pdos_at5_o (MgO), and output.txt (a Si riper SCF run). The orthogonalized CIF that the app downloaded was pasted back into the converter. output.txt does contain a 'Fermi Level Statistics' block, but in an older format without the '(au)' suffix. The Bands Plot parser requires that suffix, so it rejected output.txt as a Fermi reference. output.txt is also a Si run and does not match the band files used.

features.name: Structure-to-input converter with format and parser choice
features.general: Pick an input file format and a parsing library, paste or upload the file, inspect the parsed lattice, atoms and 3D view, then copy or download the generated input blocks for a simulation code
features.specific: Choose CIF/XYZ/CAR/POSCAR/PWSCF/Extended XYZ/TMOL, pick the ASE or PYMATGEN CIF parser, paste or upload the file, and get $coord in Bohr plus $cell angs/$periodic/$kpoints with a Download coord file button
steps: choose the file format
choose the CIF parser
paste the text or upload the file
check the lattice vectors, atomic coordinates and 3D view
copy the control text or download coord
serves_tasks: Convert a structure file into the simulation program's coordinate and cell input
Feed the transformed cell back into input generation

features.name: Fractional translation sliders with live regenerated input
features.general: Slide the whole structure along each cell axis by a fraction of the lattice vector, see the wrapped result in 3D, and get regenerated coordinates and a structure file
features.specific: Translate along a/b/c sliders (-1 to 1) on the Convert page, which give a 3D view, 'RIPER Files for the Translated Structure' and a Download CIF for the translated structure
steps: drag the a, b or c slider
look at the updated 3D view
copy the translated $coord block
optionally download the translated CIF
serves_tasks: Shift the atoms rigidly within the periodic cell before writing input

features.name: High-symmetry k-path generator with periodicity switch
features.general: From a crystal file, optionally reduce to the primitive cell, detect the lattice type, list the special reciprocal-space points and path, and emit a ready-to-paste path block for 3D or 2D periodicity
features.specific: Band Structure Path: 'Convert to primitive cell?' checkbox, space group from pymatgen and ASE, Bravais lattice, special k-points JSON, path string (e.g. GMKGALHA,LM,KH or GMKG for 2D), and control text with kptlines/recipr lines and $periodic 2 or 3
steps: upload or paste a CIF
keep or untick primitive-cell conversion
choose PBC 3D or 2D
read the special points and path
copy the $kpoints kptlines block and coords
serves_tasks: Generate a high-symmetry reciprocal-space path for a band-structure run

features.name: Cell orthogonalizer with before/after comparison and strain report
features.general: Show the original cell, transform it into an equivalent rectangular supercell, report the strain introduced, and export the new cell file
features.specific: Orthogonalizer: Original Structure 3D view and lattice table, Orthogonalize Cell button, Orthogonalized Structure view and table, Strain array, Download Orthogonal Cell CIF
steps: paste or upload a CIF
check the original lattice vectors
press Orthogonalize Cell
check the new lattice vectors and strain
download the orthogonal CIF
serves_tasks: Turn a skewed periodic cell into an equivalent rectangular supercell

features.name: Band-edge energy reference selector with gap detection
features.general: Set the zero of energy for a band plot either automatically at the valence-band top (from ranked gap candidates or a given count of occupied bands), or by a custom value or reference file, and report the resulting gap
features.specific: Bands Plot section 1: optional riper output upload for the exact Fermi level (it needs a 'Fermi Level Statistics (au)' block and was not shown working in this run), the 'Where to put E = 0?' radio (Automatic VBM / Custom value), a 'Detected gap candidates' dropdown, a number-of-occupied-bands field, an energy shift in a.u. with its eV equivalent, and a summary line 'E = 0 at the VBM: band 14 … gap 0.626 eV'
steps: upload the band file
optionally upload the matching riper output
choose Automatic VBM or Custom value
pick a gap candidate or set the number of occupied bands, or type the shift
read the reported VBM band and gap
serves_tasks: Plot an electronic band structure referenced to the band edge and find the gap

features.name: Band-structure plotter with path labels and fat-band projection overlay
features.general: Plot dispersion curves along a path within an energy window, label the path breakpoints, optionally overlay marker sizes for chosen components, and export the figure and plotted data
features.specific: Bands Plot sections 2–3: energy window min/max, Show all bands, a comma-separated high-symmetry label field (with a warning when the label count does not match the segment boundaries), a Projection buckets multiselect (element mg/o total, s, p, d), line style, colour and width, fat-band marker scale and opacity, Download plot as PNG and Download the plotted bands as CSV
steps: set the energy window
type the path labels to match the segment boundaries
for projected files, choose projection buckets
adjust the line and marker styling
download the PNG or CSV
serves_tasks: Plot an electronic band structure referenced to the band edge and find the gap
Show which atoms or orbitals make up each band

features.name: Multi-file DOS loader with auto-recognition and sum-rule check
features.general: Drop many component data files at once, have each one classified automatically (total, per-element, per-atom, spin, columns), and check that the components add up to the total
features.specific: DOS Plot: a multi-file uploader for dos/pdos_* (or a .zip), the 'Data that was recognised' table (file, type, label, spin, columns, points), and a green 'Sum rule satisfied … largest deviation 1.00e-05' banner
steps: upload dos together with the pdos_* files
read the recognised-data table
read the sum-rule check result
serves_tasks: Plot total and component-resolved densities of states and check that the parts add up to the total

features.name: Curve picker with quick-selection presets and styled DOS plot
features.general: Choose which component curves to plot with one-click presets and then edit the selection chip by chip; restyle the plot (units, axis range, shading, grid, reference line) and export the data and figure
features.specific: Quick selection radio (Elements (total), Atoms (total), Projections split by l, Total DOS split by l, Custom) feeding a Curves multiselect; energy unit eV/Hartree, Shade the total DOS, line width, Grid, Line at the Fermi level, axis min/max, title; Download plot as PNG, Download the plotted data as CSV, and a 'Show the plotted data as a table' expander

remove or add individual curves
set the energy unit and axis range
toggle shading, grid and the Fermi line
download the CSV or PNG or view the table
serves_tasks: Plot total and component-resolved densities of states and check that the parts add up to the total

features.name: SCF log parser with convergence plot and structure recovery
features.general: Paste or upload a run log, get a table of per-iteration quantities, plot a chosen quantity against iteration, and recover the final structure with distances and regenerated input
features.specific: Output Parser: a Parsed Energies table (kinetic, Coulomb, XC, total, DIIS error), Plotly/Matplotlib tabs with a 'Select the y-axis value' dropdown, periodicity detection, structure info with Interatomic Distances, Download CIF, and RIPER coord/control blocks
steps: paste or upload the riper output
read the per-iteration table
choose the y-axis quantity and read the convergence plot
check the structure and interatomic distances
download the CIF or coord
